remarks: Welcome to 12 Alfred Lane. Located in prestigious Westover, Doral Farm consists of 59 detached luxury homes on 60 private acres with a pool, clubhouse & tennis court. This beautiful, spacious home is perfectly situated on a cul-de-sac with a private driveway, large rear deck which overlooks beautifully landscaped grounds. Come experience this renovated and meticulously maintained home. Through the entry foyer you will see the 2 story great room with vaulted ceilings, marble fireplace and skylights. It leads to a room currently used as an office and exercise room, with built-in bookcases. Continue on to the modern and thoughtfully designed "Rutt" kitchen with unique cabinetry, appliances, Sub-Zero fridge and freezer drawers, ice maker, granite island/countertops and custom backsplash. The adjacent living room has a marble fireplace and sliders to the large deck. The formal dining room has built-in hutches. There is an updated powder room, separate laundry room and 2 car garage complete the main level. The upper level has an oversized master bedroom suite with built-in closets and storage. The updated master bathroom has a large shower, double sink, walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms, a full bathroom and 2 attic spaces complete this level. Be sure to see the Renovation & Updates Sheet in the "Documents" section along with "Additional Features."
